principle: Lesson 1 recognises patterns from English; lessons 2–4 use short familiar sentences; later lessons add story detail and reference forms.

introductions.title: Simple comparisons and habits
introductions.pattern: He … ake … i · … ai · ia rā

pairs.mi: He nui ake te kura i te whare.

extensionPairs.mi: He teitei ake te rākau i te whare.

introductions.title: Simple why and when questions

extensionPairs.mi: He aha koe i pātai ai ki te kaiako?

extensionPairs.mi: Nōnahea koe i tākaro ai?

introductions.title: If this happens

pairs.mi: Ki te oma koe, ka oma ahau.
pairs.en: If you run, I will run.

extensionPairs.mi: Ki te haere koe ki te marae, ka haere ahau ki te marae.
extensionPairs.en: If you go to the marae, I will go to the marae.

extensionPairs.mi: Ki te ua āpōpō, ka noho ahau ki te kāinga.
extensionPairs.en: If it rains tomorrow, I will stay at home.

extensionPairs.mi: Ki te moe te tamaiti, ka pānui ahau i te pukapuka.
extensionPairs.en: If the child sleeps, I will read the book.
